title: zehneria leucocarpa
intro: Zehneria leucocarpa, commonly known as White Apple Cucumber or White Apple Gourd, is a plant species belonging to the family Cucurbitaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Zehneria leucocarpa are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
